verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents a first-party hosted MCP server at https://mcp.rudderstack.com/mcp with connection instructions (e.g., `claude mcp add`). It works with MCP clients such as Claude, Codex, Cursor and VS Code, and its documented tools cover delivery-error debugging, transformation authoring and testing, tracking plan review and duplicate-event detection. A probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: For Claude Code, run claude mcp add --transport http rudderstack https://mcp.rudderstack.com/mcp.
RudderStack MCP works with any MCP-compatible client like Claude, Codex, Cursor, Visual Studio Code (GitHub Copilot), etc.
Debug delivery errors, monitor pipelines, write and test transformations, review audit logs — all through natural language.
